_comment: Permission config for pi-permission-system (github.com/MasuRii/pi-permission-system). Install first: pi install git:github.com/MasuRii/pi-permission-system. Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom; last matching rule wins. Policies: allow (no prompt), ask (prompt user), deny (block with message).

bash.reason: Recursive delete blocked. Use 'rm' with explicit paths.
Force push blocked. Use --force-with-lease if absolutely necessary.
Hard reset blocks are load-bearing — confirm manually.
Untracked file deletion requires explicit approval.
Env file reads blocked. Access secrets via env vars only.

bash._comment: Safe read-only operations — allow without prompt

write._ordering_comment: Rules evaluate top-to-bottom; last matching rule wins. Put safe-area allows BEFORE critical denies so denies always take precedence.
write._comment: Safe work areas — allow without prompt
Sensitive config — deny (evaluated after allows; wins for these paths)
write.reason: Writing to env files blocked. Update via system environment only.

write._comment: Infrastructure — never write raw; use the extension API or sqlite3 CLI
write.reason: Direct writes to memory.db blocked. Use the memory-db extension API or sqlite3 for intentional DB operations.
Writing into node_modules blocked. Run npm/yarn install instead.

edit._comment: Safe work areas — allow without prompt

edit.reason: Direct edits to memory.db blocked. Use sqlite3 for intentional DB operations.
